whyOrigin.heading: Same saffron belt. A second origin.
paragraphs: Herat and Iranian Khorasan share one saffron-growing belt, one border apart: the same crocus, the same altitude, the same harvest window — without Iranian banking or sanctions exposure.
Afghanistan is not listed in EU Regulation 2019/1793, so there are no increased official border checks for these products into the EU and EEA.
Adding Afghan origin next to your current suppliers spreads your crop and price risk.

quality.heading: Tested, not just promised
quality.text: Every sample and every lot comes with laboratory analysis. For saffron this follows ISO 3632: colouring strength (crocin), aroma (safranal), bitterness (picrocrocin) and moisture. For nuts and dried fruit it includes aflatoxins.
spotItems: Real Super Negin is all red — yellow or white ends are style, not stigma.
In water, real saffron releases its golden colour slowly. Instant red colour often means dye.
Ask for the lab test. A serious supplier will always provide it.

about.title: Raw material from the origin
paragraphs: SERAJ is a small export business based in Istanbul, run by Seraj Yaqubi. We source saffron from Herat and nuts and dried fruit from across Afghanistan, and supply them in bulk to manufacturers, packers, importers and wholesalers.
We sell raw material only. We do no retail packing, no labelling and no private label, and we have no consumer brand of our own — so we never compete with our customers.
We keep minimums small and test every lot, because we would rather earn a long relationship with a first small order than chase one large one.
